Zoe (People Ops): FYI launching a small microgrant + recognition drop for Q2. Managers: nominate up to 2 people, include 1-line impact + preferred reward (pin / donation / digital-card). Deadline Tue 5/21.
Hector: Do we have a hard cap on dollar value?
Zoe (People Ops): $40 cap per award unless pre-approved by Finance.
Lina: Can winners opt for an internal profile badge instead of a gift?
Zoe (People Ops): Yes — add 'profile_badge' as an option in the sheet.
Evan (Finance): Note: digital cards count toward the same budget. Also, international physical shipments may need customs paperwork; we'll flag those after nominations.
ShipBot: [system] Inventory snapshot: pins=60, enamel_mugs=25, digital_cards=150. Lead time for new pin order: 10 business days.
Hector: If pins run out, can we substitute a digital card?
Zoe (People Ops): Yes, we will default to digital card substitution and notify managers. Please fill the spreadsheet linked in the announcement channel.
Zoe (People Ops): I'll consolidate on Wed and route to Finance by Thu. Thanks all. :sparkles:
